speaker: Unknown
en: Whitney Wolfe Heard, at 25, started Bumble.
zh: Whitney Wolfe Heard，在 25 岁时创办了 Bumble。

speaker: Unknown
en: You became the youngest woman to take a company public in U.S. history.
zh: 你成为了美国历史上让公司上市的最年轻女性。

speaker: Unknown
en: Incredible accolades.
zh: 令人难以置信的荣誉。

speaker: Unknown
en: You famously left the company.
zh: 你 famously 离开了这家公司。

speaker: Unknown
en: You've returned, now a CEO, trying to turn it around.
zh: 你已经回归了，现在是 CEO，试图扭转局面。

speaker: Unknown
en: Should we expect this return to be permanent?
zh: 我们应该预期这次回归是永久性的吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: Is this what you're doing forever?
zh: 这是你要永远做的事情吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: Or is this just a temporary thing?
zh: 还是这只是一个临时的事情？

speaker: Unknown
en: You know, it's interesting.
zh: 你知道，这很有趣。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'm just so in love with Bumble.
zh: 我只是太爱 Bumble 了。

speaker: Unknown
en: I mean, it's just one of those things that I don't see Bumble as a job.
zh: 我的意思是，这只是我不把 Bumble 视为工作的事情之一。

speaker: Unknown
en: I really don't.
zh: 我真的不这么认为。

speaker: Unknown
en: I don't wake up in the morning and say, oh, I've got to go to work.
zh: 我早上醒来不会说，哦，我得去工作了。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's funny.
zh: 很有趣。

speaker: Unknown
en: I have three children.
zh: 我有三个孩子。

speaker: Unknown
en: But I do see Bumble as almost a form of a child to me in some degree because...
zh: 但在某种程度上，我的确把 Bumble 视为几乎是我的孩子的一种形式，因为……

speaker: Unknown
en: I built this from sheer passion and grit, and it's just been this labor of love and resilience for so long.
zh: 我纯粹凭借激情和勇气构建了它，这长期以来一直是一种爱的努力和韧性的体现。

speaker: Unknown
en: So I don't have a time horizon for how long I'll do something, but I'm always the type of person that says I'll show up when needed.
zh: 所以我对我要做这件事的时间跨度没有预期，但我总是那种会在被需要时出现的人。

speaker: Unknown
en: And if I'm the best person for the role, I'll be here as long as it needs me.
zh: 如果我是这个角色的最佳人选，只要它需要我，我就会在这里。

speaker: Unknown
en: This company is undergoing a major shift, and you're at the helm of that.
zh: 这家正在经历重大转变，你正处于掌舵地位。

speaker: Unknown
en: Can you just give me the quick summary of why you think Bumble needs a reset?
zh: 你能给我一个快速的总结，说明为什么你认为 Bumble 需要一次重置？

speaker: Unknown
en: Yes.
zh: 是的。

speaker: Unknown
en: So I think every company has, it has to grow, evolve and change or companies die.
zh: 所以我认为每家公司都有，它必须成长、进化和改变，否则公司就会消亡。

speaker: Unknown
en: That is life.
zh: 这就是生活。

speaker: Unknown
en: And if you look at every great company, no company just stays flat or stagnant.
zh: 如果你看看每家伟大的公司，没有哪家公司只是保持平坦或停滞不前。

speaker: Unknown
en: If you look at Apple, there's new products, there's new releases, there's new launches.
zh: 如果你看看 Apple，有新产品，有新发布，有新推出。

speaker: Unknown
en: You're not using the iPhone that you had seven years ago.
zh: 你不会在用你七年前的 iPhone。

speaker: Unknown
en: Bumble's product is still the product you had seven years ago.
zh: Bumble 的产品仍然是你七年前的那个产品。

speaker: Unknown
en: We have been operating on legacy tech infrastructure, and we are now overhauling that, building a modernized system so that we can deliver the product that members today both need, deserve, but also want.
zh: 我们一直在使用遗留的技术基础设施运营，我们现在正在彻底改革它，构建一个现代化的系统，以便我们能够提供今天的成员既需要、值得但也想要的产品。

speaker: Unknown
en: You know, behavior has changed.
zh: 你知道，行为已经改变了。

speaker: Unknown
en: When I started this company,
zh: 当我创办这家公司时，

speaker: Unknown
en: It was very novel and very revolutionary to be using your phone to date.
zh: 用手机约会是非常新颖和非常革命性的。

speaker: Unknown
en: A young woman just out of college would have never imagined online dating when I was starting this company.
zh: 当我刚创办这家公司时，一个刚大学毕业的年轻女性绝不会想象在线约会。

speaker: Unknown
en: It was revolutionary.
zh: 那是革命性的。

speaker: Unknown
en: Now the revolutionary component of Bumble has worn off.
zh: 现在 Bumble 的革命性成分已经消退了。

speaker: Unknown
en: Now people are feeling exhausted.
zh: 现在人们感到筋疲力尽。

speaker: Unknown
en: They're feeling fatigued.
zh: 他们感到疲劳。

speaker: Unknown
en: They feel like the swipe has degraded their love lives.
zh: 他们觉得滑动已经 degraded 了他们的爱情生活。

speaker: Unknown
en: I saw something posted on your Instagram this morning that Bumble is maybe getting rid of the swipe.
zh: 我今天早上在你的 Instagram 上看到一条帖子，说 Bumble 可能会 rid 滑动。

speaker: Unknown
en: Is that true?
zh: 这是真的吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: We are evolving into our next chapter.
zh: 我们正在进入我们的下一个篇章。

speaker: Unknown
en: And we are, you know, synonymous with being the product where we put women in control.
zh: 我们是，你知道，作为我们把女性置于控制之中的产品的代名词。

speaker: Unknown
en: Our first move as a company was really...
zh: 我们作为一家公司的第一步真的是……

speaker: Unknown
en: having women go first and make that first move.
zh: 让女性先走，迈出第一步。

speaker: Unknown
en: And what we're saying internally is it's time for that next move.
zh: 我们内部在说的是，是时候进行下一步行动了。

speaker: Unknown
en: And that next move is not merely a better profile.
zh: 而下一步行动不仅仅是一个更好的资料。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's not merely a better UI, UX, or simply a better recommendation engine, which, by the way, we're doing all of those.
zh: 这不仅仅是一个更好的 UI、UX，或者仅仅是一个更好的推荐引擎，顺便说一句，我们正在做所有这些。

speaker: Unknown
en: The algorithm is the key to everything, making sure you see who you want to see, connect with who you want to connect with.
zh: 算法是一切的关键，确保你看到你想看到的人，与你想要联系的人建立联系。

speaker: Unknown
en: But it's time for a new interaction model.
zh: 但是时候采用新的交互模式了。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's time for the next Bumble.
zh: 是时候迎接下一个 Bumble 了。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so to answer the question, we are going to be saying goodbye to the swipe and hello to something.
zh: 所以为了回答这个问题，我们将告别滑动，向某事物问好。

speaker: Unknown
en: that I believe is revolutionary for the category, and I'm very excited about it.
zh: 我认为这对该类别来说是革命性的，我对此非常兴奋。

speaker: Unknown
en: Wow.
zh: 哇。

speaker: Unknown
en: Okay, so if the app reset is coming in Q4, we should expect the functionality of how we say yes or no to a potential match to not be a swiping mechanism.
zh: 好的，所以如果应用重置将在第四季度到来，我们应该期待关于如何对潜在匹配说是或否的功能不再是一种滑动机制。

speaker: Unknown
en: In select markets, in Q4, the swipe will be gone.
zh: 在精选市场，在第四季度，滑动将消失。

speaker: Unknown
en: Fascinating.
zh: 迷人。

speaker: Unknown
en: And let's talk a little bit about why we're doing this reset.
zh: 让我们谈谈为什么要进行这次重置。

speaker: Unknown
en: One of the things that you have said is that you want to have sort of a more intentional user base.
zh: 你曾说过的一件事是，你想要一个更有意图的用户群。

speaker: Unknown
en: The business, though, is interesting.
zh: 这项业务很有趣。

speaker: Unknown
en: You've had paid users decline.
zh: 你的付费用户有所下降。

speaker: Unknown
en: You said that's part of this new reset, right, to get the company back to a healthier place.
zh: 你说这是这次新重置的一部分，对吧，为了让公司回到一个更健康的地方。

speaker: Unknown
en: But is losing paid users really the way to get there?
zh: 但失去付费用户真的是到达那里的方式吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: So not all paid customers are created equal.
zh: 所以并非所有付费客户都是生而平等的。

speaker: Unknown
en: I think this is something that is very lost on the investment community, frankly.
zh: 我认为这是投资界非常容易忽略的一点，坦率地说。

speaker: Unknown
en: They look at numbers as an overall volume.
zh: 他们把数字看作整体量。

speaker: Unknown
en: But what they failed to realize is calling the system and forcing quality over quantity means that there are some low quality payers that we have intentionally said goodbye to.
zh: 但他们未能意识到的是，调用系统和强制质量重于数量意味着我们有意告别了一些低质量的付费用户。

speaker: Unknown
en: You know, what people fail to realize is a portion of the payer drop.
zh: 你知道，人们未能意识到的是，付费用户下降的一部分。

speaker: Unknown
en: was low quality spam-like behavior.
zh: 是低质量的垃圾邮件般的行为。

speaker: Unknown
en: Why would we want a payer in the system that is degrading the experience, particularly for women?
zh: 为什么我们会想要一个系统中降低体验的付费用户，尤其是对女性而言？

speaker: Unknown
en: So we would much rather take a short-term hit on total payer numbers to really do the job that we set out to do as a very multi-stage process, which we're now entering phase two of.
zh: 所以我们宁愿在总付费用户数量上承受短期打击，也要真正完成我们设定为一个非常多阶段过程的工作，我们现在正在进入第二阶段。

speaker: Unknown
en: The first phase was call system of low quality, low intent behavior.
zh: 第一阶段是调用低质量、低意图行为的系统。

speaker: Unknown
en: enforce better authenticity and better checkpoints to create a higher quality member base.
zh: 强制执行更好的真实性检查点，以创建更高质量的会员基础。

speaker: Unknown
en: We are member obsessed.
zh: 我们是会员痴迷的。

speaker: Unknown
en: The number one member complaint when I stepped back in as CEO was that women said they felt like the people they were seeing were not who they actually were.
zh: 当我重新回到 CEO 的位置时，会员的第一大投诉是，女性说她们觉得她们看到的人不是她们本人。

speaker: Unknown
en: They felt like the quality of behavior was low.
zh: 她们觉得行为质量很低。

speaker: Unknown
en: They felt like they were, you know, they were experiencing low quality.
zh: 她们觉得她们正在，你知道，经历低质量。

speaker: Unknown
en: So we said, okay, let's reset and overhaul the supply.
zh: 所以我们说，好吧，让我们重置并彻底改变供应。

speaker: Unknown
en: Step two is really overhauling the UX, the back end, which we're almost done with, and the interaction model and the profile and the way in which we interact with these higher quality members.
zh: 第二步是真正彻底改变 UX、后端——我们几乎完成了——以及交互模型和档案，以及我们与这些更高质量会员互动的方式。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so that's the way I think about payers.
zh: 所以这就是我思考付费用户的方式。

speaker: Unknown
en: The other interesting thing about payers and what I think a lot of the investment community fails to realize as well is people will go to the ends of the world for love.
zh: 关于付费用户，另一件有趣的事情，以及我认为很多投资界也未能意识到的是，人们会为了爱走到天涯海角。

speaker: Unknown
en: If you actually look at how much people are willing to pay,
zh: 如果你真的看看人们愿意付多少钱，

speaker: Unknown
en: to go out on high-quality dates through, whether that's real-life matchmakers or coaches or people to help them show up better, it is a lot higher than the subscription costs that we have.
zh: 去通过……参加高质量约会，无论是现实生活中的媒人、教练还是帮助他们表现得更好的人，这比我们要高得多。目前的订阅成本。

speaker: Unknown
en: And we haven't even entered into this phase of a reimagination of our revenue potential.
zh: 我们甚至还没有进入重新想象我们收入潜力的这个阶段。

speaker: Unknown
en: So I fundamentally believe when you have...
zh: 所以我根本相信当你拥有……

speaker: Unknown
en: all of the pieces in place, a higher quality member base, check, a new interaction model, a modernized profile, a next-gen recommendation engine, a modern tech stack, and all of those components to come together with a more premium subscription offering.
zh: 所有要素到位，更高质量的会员基础，勾选，新的交互模型，现代化的档案，下一代推荐引擎，现代技术堆栈，以及所有这些组件与更高级的订阅产品结合在一起。

speaker: Unknown
en: This is poised for the turnaround that I came back for.
zh: 这为扭转局势做好了准备，这也是我回来的原因。

speaker: Unknown
en: You're sort of suggesting that Wall Street doesn't fully understand the current and potential value of this app.
zh: 你是在暗示华尔街并不完全理解该应用的当前和潜在价值。

speaker: Unknown
en: Why keep it public?
zh: 为什么要保持上市状态？

speaker: Unknown
en: Is there a chance that you would consider taking it private with investors that are strategic and would understand this vision?
zh: 你是否有可能考虑与理解这一愿景的战略性投资者一起将其私有化？

speaker: Unknown
en: So we are always exploring what's best for the shareholders.
zh: 所以我们总是在探索对股东来说什么是最有利的。

speaker: Unknown
en: I obviously cannot comment on what the structural future of the company would or would not be.
zh: 我显然不能评论公司的结构未来会是什么或不会是什么。

speaker: Unknown
en: But what I will say is I think the benefit that I have garnered
zh: 但我想说的是，我认为我获得的好处

speaker: Unknown
en: over the last few years of being a public company CEO is I'm thick as, I'm tough as nails now.
zh: 在过去几年作为上市公司 CEO 的经历是，我变得像……一样坚韧，我现在像钉子一样硬。

speaker: Unknown
en: I mean, you really can't hurt me.
zh: 我的意思是，你真的不能伤害我。

speaker: Unknown
en: So, you know, my stock drops 40%.
zh: 所以，你知道，我的股票下跌了 40%。

speaker: Unknown
en: It goes up 40%.
zh: 它上涨了 40%。

speaker: Unknown
en: I keep showing up with the same level of passion, purpose, focus.
zh: 我继续保持同样的激情、目标、专注。

speaker: Unknown
en: You cannot rock me.
zh: 你动摇不了我。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I think that this has been...
zh: 我认为这真的是……

speaker: Unknown
en: truly a masterclass in just learning how to stay focused on the long term because you get pulled all over the place being a public company CEO.
zh: 关于学习如何保持专注于长期的大师课，因为作为一家上市公司的 CEO，你会被拉向四面八方。

speaker: Unknown
en: Whether this is forever or not, we'll see what's best for the company at the right time.
zh: 这是否会永远如此，我们到时候会看什么对公司最有利。

speaker: Unknown
en: And in the meantime, we just keep delivering good product and working hard behind the scenes.
zh: 在此期间，我们要继续提供好的产品，并在幕后努力工作。

speaker: Unknown
en: I think the model you're describing where you have fewer members that pay more because they're more deeply engaged.
zh: 我认为你描述的那个拥有较少付费成员但付费更多的模型，因为他们参与得更深。

speaker: Unknown
en: It makes sense.
zh: 这是有道理的。

speaker: Unknown
en: But at the same time, you know, your mission really is about making dating accessible to everybody.
zh: 但同时，你知道，你的使命确实是让每个人都能接触约会。

speaker: Unknown
en: So how do you make sure that your app remains accessible to anyone who wants to date when you're trying to push people more towards a paid experience?
zh: 那么当你试图将人们更多地推向付费体验时，你如何确保你的应用程序对任何想要约会的人仍然开放？

speaker: Unknown
en: So I think if you look at the way monetization has been working at Bumble historically...
zh: 所以我认为如果你看看 Bumble 历史上变现运作的方式……

speaker: Unknown
en: We've almost monetized in the capacity of saying, hey, this freemium experience is maybe not great.
zh: 我们几乎是以这种能力变现的，即嘿，这个免费增值体验可能不太好。

speaker: Unknown
en: Pay us and you'll get a better experience.
zh: 付钱给我们，你会得到更好的体验。

speaker: Unknown
en: It feels almost like engagement bait.
zh: 这感觉几乎像是参与诱饵。

speaker: Unknown
en: So the future of the monetization model in this new interaction and relaunch is let's give everyone something great.
zh: 所以这种新互动和重新发布中变现模型的未来是让我们给每个人一些好的东西。

speaker: Unknown
en: Let's just make the free experience great.
zh: 让我们只是让免费体验变得很棒。

speaker: Unknown
en: But you're going to want more of a good thing.
zh: 但你会想要更多好的东西。

speaker: Unknown
en: And what I could say, you know, here is instead of paying for less of a bad thing.
zh: 我可以说的是，你知道，这里不是为减少坏东西而付费。

speaker: Unknown
en: Let's actually find interesting modalities to allow you to opt into more premium offerings to get more of a good thing.
zh: 让我们实际上找到有趣的模态，让你选择加入更多的高级产品以获得更多好的东西。

speaker: Unknown
en: And that's the way we're approaching this.
zh: 这就是我们接近这件事的方式。

speaker: Unknown
en: What does that look like that's different in the future than what you get today?
zh: 这看起来与今天相比未来有什么不同？

speaker: Unknown
en: Because today there are a lot of different ways you can optimize with paid.
zh: 因为今天有很多不同的方式你可以通过付费进行优化。

speaker: Unknown
en: Are you saying that those things will now move to free and there's even different things that become paid?
zh: 你是说这些东西现在将转移到免费版，并且还有不同的东西变成付费吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: So it's very hard to talk about this without telling you what this new product is.
zh: 所以如果不告诉你这个新产品是什么，很难谈论这件事。

speaker: Unknown
en: And due to the competitive nature and we're not ready to launch it, it's still in testing.
zh: 由于竞争的性质，我们还没准备好发布它，它仍在测试中。

speaker: Unknown
en: I can't give you all the details.
zh: 我不能给你所有的细节。

speaker: Unknown
en: What I will say is that right now...
zh: 我要说的是，目前……

speaker: Unknown
en: One of the major pain points that we hear from members is that the free experience is not great.
zh: 我们从成员那里听到的主要痛点之一是，免费体验并不好。

speaker: Unknown
en: They feel like in order to get any value from our product, they're almost ushered into needing to pay.
zh: 他们觉得为了从我们的产品中获得任何价值，他们几乎被引导去付费。

speaker: Unknown
en: And what we're realizing is not all cohorts are interested in paying.
zh: 我们意识到的是，并非所有群体都愿意付费。

speaker: Unknown
en: Some are looking to...
zh: 有些人正在寻找……

speaker: Unknown
en: experience something great before they pay.
zh: 在付费之前体验一些很棒的东西。

speaker: Unknown
en: There's different engagement mechanisms that you have with different audiences.
zh: 你与不同的受众有不同的互动机制。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so the way that we're really approaching this is building experiences that are so good and letting you have a bit of it for free.
zh: 所以我们真正接近这件事的方式是构建非常好的体验，并让你免费获得其中的一部分。

speaker: Unknown
en: But just like you're seeing with the AI models, you cannot just go build on cloud code all day long for free.
zh: 但就像你在 AI 模型上看到的那样，你不能整天免费在云代码上构建。

speaker: Unknown
en: You can try it.
zh: 你可以尝试它。

speaker: Unknown
en: And then when you want more, you have to upgrade.
zh: 当你想要更多时，你必须升级。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so that will basically be the way we think about this is how do we give you something good?
zh: 所以这基本上就是我们思考这件事的方式，即我们如何给你一些好的东西？

speaker: Unknown
en: It's working.
zh: 它是有效的。

speaker: Unknown
en: You're happy with it.
zh: 你对它很满意。

speaker: Unknown
en: But to access it further, deeper, more intentionally, there are going to be more premium offerings.
zh: 但要更深入、更刻意地访问它，会有更多的高级产品。

speaker: Unknown
en: Also, if you want a more curated experience, if you want a more high-touch experience, Bee, for example, Bee is our AI assistant.
zh: 此外，如果你想要更精心策划的体验，如果你想要更高端的体验，Bee，例如，Bee 是我们的 AI 助手。

speaker: Unknown
en: our AI dating assistant.
zh: 我们的 AI 约会助手。

speaker: Unknown
en: So what you will see starting in Q4 and through 2027, B will start to come to life as a premium offering.
zh: 所以你将从第四季度开始到 2027 年看到，B 将开始作为一种高级产品呈现。

speaker: Unknown
en: And the willingness that we've already seen through testing has been extremely encouraging and illuminating.
zh: 我们通过测试已经看到的意愿是非常令人鼓舞和具有启发性的。

speaker: Unknown
en: People are willing to spend such a deep amount of time talking to our AI assistant, getting to know
zh: 人们愿意花大量的时间与我们的 AI 助手交谈，了解……
